lines.say: MiroFish is / a prediction engine / built on a swarm / of AI agents.
You upload seed material: / breaking news / or a policy draft. / It builds / a parallel digital world / with thousands of agents.
Each agent has / its own personality / and long-term memory. / Together, they interact / and evolve.
Then you change / a variable / from a God's-eye view / and watch / where the future goes.
You get / a detailed prediction report, / and you can chat / with any agent.
Decision makers / test policies / at zero risk. / Or you play out / a novel's ending.
76.7k stars, / incubated by Shanda Group, / with simulations / running on OASIS / from CAMEL-AI.
You need an LLM key / in OpenAI format / and a free Zep key.
Two npm commands / start it. / Begin with fewer / than 40 rounds: / consumption is high.
Try the live demo, / then send this / to the friend / who always asks / what if.
MiroFish. / Rehearse the future / in a digital sandbox.
